prompt:
做一组珐琅彩（掐丝珐琅）质感的游戏道具：游戏勋章、头像框、武器各一个，用 WebGL2 渲染，每件都要有立体感。
1. 结构：金色掐丝线勾出每块色区并凸起，色区里填红、蓝、绿等珐琅釉；宝石用金色包边镶嵌；武器刀身为银色金属，带中脊。
2. 立体：用高度图生成法线，金线和包边最高，釉面在格子里略微鼓起，边缘模糊过渡成圆润倒角。
3. 材质：金和银反射柔和的影棚灯光并带锐利高光；珐琅釉保留自身颜色，格子深处色调更深，表面有一层清漆般的细小反光；宝石更饱和、闪光更强。

5. 细节：逐帧检查 DPR，变化才重设画布；不支持 WebGL2 时显示平面贴图；减少动态效果时停止光源动画；卸载时释放 GPU 资源。

en.title: Cloisonné Enamel
en.description: A game medal, avatar frame and sword in raised gold wire, coloured enamel and set gems, tilting with the cursor under a moving light for real depth.
en.tags: Web effects / Cloisonné / WebGL2 / Game items / 3D material
en.prompt:
Build a set of cloisonné-enamel game items — a game medal, an avatar frame and a weapon — rendered in WebGL2, each with a strong sense of depth.
1. Structure: raised gold wire outlines every colour field, filled with red, blue, green and other enamel glazes; gems sit in gold bezels; the weapon blade is silver metal with a central ridge.
2. Depth: derive normals from a height map — gold wires and bezels highest, glaze slightly domed inside each cell, edges blurred into rounded bevels.
3. Materials: gold and silver reflect soft studio light with sharp highlights; enamel keeps its own colour, deeper in the cells, with a fine clear-coat glint; gems are more saturated and sparkle more.
4. Interaction: when the pointer moves over an item it tilts on a spring (±14°) and the light follows the pointer, returning when it leaves; when idle the light slowly orbits so highlights keep moving.
5. Details: check DPR every frame and resize the canvas only when it changes; without WebGL2 show the flat texture; stop the light animation under reduced motion; release GPU resources on unload.
